g.text: L1 (write-through, direct mapped): 3 states, TAG_CHECK is combinational

g.text: No EVICT state exists: write-through lines are never dirty, so a line is simply overwritten.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: A store hit updates the L1 array and is forwarded to L2 (a one-entry skid holds the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: forward if L2 is not ready); a store miss is allocated, merged and then forwarded.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: Writes are posted: a store hit or a write-allocated miss returns to IDLE without a response.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: L2 and L3 differ only in parameters (ways, line size, write width) and in what sits downstream:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: the adapter for L2, the AXI4 fill engine for L3. A free (invalid) way is always used before

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: the PLRU choice evicts a live line. Misses are blocking: one outstanding miss per level.
